oak-lab.description: A compact friendly research room in Pallet Town. Cream walls, broad blue window LEFT, a wooden desk on RIGHT with three CLOSED red-white Poke Balls arranged left-to-right, a simple red book-shaped Pokedex, one wooden chair beside desk. Bookshelf on rear wall, ordinary door at back left. Pale wooden floor. No screens with writing, no capsules, fantasy towers or people.

pallet-court.description: A small outdoor packed-earth training court beside low cream houses with red roofs. Broad grassy strip and wood fence at back, path exits left, two modest shrubs at right. Thin white boundary marks on ground, no inscriptions. Afternoon warm daylight. Human-height three-quarter view. No people or Pokemon.

route-fork.description: A clean woodland path forks in two at center background, low shrubs and modest trees frame both sides. Small simple wooden direction post at the fork, no letters. A fallen log on left foreground, low flat rock right. Moderate daylight, readable forest depth with restrained background detail. No people or Pokemon.

campsite-day.description: A woodland clearing off the northbound route. Low green triangular canvas tent on LEFT, two simple bowls (blue and orange) beside the entrance, a rolled tan sleeping mat partly visible inside. One sturdy fallen log on RIGHT and one low safe circular stone firepit at center foreground, unlit. Low shrubs and ordinary tree trunks behind, no deep fantasy landscape. Morning daylight, human-height wide view. No people or Pokemon.

pond.description: A quiet shallow pond behind Pewter City. Water takes RIGHT half of frame, flat stony grass bank LEFT, a small patch of reeds at far right, one low tree behind bank, ordinary grey rocks across rear bank. Clear late-morning daylight, no huge mountains, fountains or bridges. Human-height wide side view; no people or Pokemon.

pewter-gym.description: Simple indoor Rock-type Gym with stone-grey walls, high rectangular windows on the LEFT, wide tan packed-earth battlefield across center, a few knee-high grey rocks on its edges. Modest elevated trainer platform on the FAR RIGHT, entry doorway on rear LEFT. Crisp white boundary marks without text. Warm even light, no pillars or throne. Empty, no Pokemon or people.

cerulean-gym.description: Small indoor Water-type Gym. One rectangular blue pool CENTER and RIGHT, broad tan safe walkway along LEFT, narrow rectangular battle platform on right above water, tiled pale blue back wall with two high windows, entry rear left. Clean broad surfaces, no letters, dark tunnels or stadium crowd. Bright daylight. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

electric-court.description: A modest industrial Gym training hall, grey-blue tiled floor with a yellow boundary rectangle, simple grey walls, one closed square double door behind, modest unmarked electrical cabinet FAR RIGHT, high window FAR LEFT. Even warm overhead lighting, ordinary architecture, no machinery maze or science-fiction starship. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

celadon-street.description: A quiet side street in Celadon. Three modest pastel storefronts on rear wall, closed blank shutters with no writing. Broad tan pavement foreground, recessed alley opening CENTER LEFT, simple low planter RIGHT, one small closed wooden crate beside it. Soft afternoon light, no giant city skyline. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

celadon-center.description: A DIFFERENT Pokemon Center from Viridian. Cream walls and mint furniture, healing counter on LEFT, blue waiting bench along RIGHT wall under one large window, closed treatment door on rear RIGHT, small unmarked mint healing machine on back-left counter. Pale blue tile floor with red trim. Bright afternoon light. Keep standardized palette but distinct furniture geography. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

saffron-gym.description: A small modern Psychic-type Gym, plain pale lavender walls, purple square battlefield on grey floor, two low square corner markers, tall rectangular window at back LEFT and a single plain doorway back RIGHT. Clean dark-purple trim. A modest trainer platform at far back. Soft even light, no neon symbols, galaxies, giant towers, magic text or floating architecture. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

viridian-gym.description: A modest Ground-type Gym, sand-coloured rectangular battlefield centered, olive-grey walls, high windows on RIGHT, dark wood trainer platform on back LEFT, plain entry door rear center. A few ordinary knee-high rocks at corners, no forest indoors, pillars or throne. Warm level lighting. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

victory-road.description: A credible rocky cave passage leading upward, rough grey stone floor, a few shallow boulders along LEFT, a gentle curving path to bright exit at upper RIGHT. Natural warm light at exit and cool ambient cave light. Readable stone geometry, no lava, giant fantasy arches, crystals or traps. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

league-foyer.description: Indigo Plateau League entrance hall. Clean cream stone walls, broad blue-grey floor, wide steps to one simple large double door CENTER rear, blue resting bench LEFT, plain recovery station/stand RIGHT. Low red banners without text or logos. Bright indirect daylight. Modest ceremonial scale, no throne, giant crowd or fantasy citadel. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

league-arena.description: A modest indoor championship battle court. Broad tan battlefield with clean white boundary lines, blue-grey walls, raised red trainer stand at FAR RIGHT and blue stand at FAR LEFT, simple doorway centered on rear wall. High windows bring even daylight. Small empty spectator rail at back, not a vast stadium. No letters, displays, trophy, giant crowd or additional arenas. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

hall-of-fame.description: A compact bright white-and-pale-blue recording room, simple low podium center, wooden desk LEFT with one plain closed laptop and red Pokedex, broad blue window RIGHT, unmarked wall display behind podium. Warm light, ordinary room scale, no trophies or dozens of Pokemon silhouettes. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

saffron-exterior.description: A modest grey building with muted lavender doorway and low purple border, normal-height centered entry door, one low cream stone wall extending at RIGHT where two people can sit, plain tan paving foreground, one low shrub LEFT. No lettering, fantasy towers, huge archways, real-world flags or crowd. Bright even daylight. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

viridian-exterior.description: A modest olive-grey Ground Gym facade, centered ordinary wood double door under low flat red-brown roof, pale sand-coloured paved approach, two knee-high grey rocks by LEFT edge, low green hedge RIGHT, no Pokemon Center sphere emblem. Bright even daylight. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

lorelei-arena.description: Compact Ice specialist League battle room: pale blue walls, one high window at rear LEFT, rectangular shallow blue pool on FAR RIGHT half and wide grey dry trainer platform LEFT, plain back-center door, simple icy-blue rail along rear wall. Room grounded, no glaciers or floating ice castles. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

bruno-arena.description: Compact Fighting specialist League battle room: warm tan stone floor, muted brown wall trim, square boundary white lines, low grey rock on RIGHT edge and small plain weight rack LEFT, centered ordinary door on back wall, two high windows at RIGHT. Modest room dimensions, no giant temple, gladiator statues or crowd. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

agatha-arena.description: Compact Ghost specialist League battle room: muted lavender tile floor with a plain rectangular battle boundary, deep grey-purple walls, one closed cream door rear LEFT, two simple warm wall lamps at rear RIGHT, low wooden trainer step across rear wall. Readable even ambient light, no coffins, ghosts, writing, spooky faces in walls or real graveyard. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

lance-arena.description: Compact Dragon specialist League battle room: pale cream floor with a dark emerald boundary rectangle, plain cream walls with emerald trim, two high blue windows upper LEFT, one closed ordinary door back RIGHT, low red trainer step centered behind battle court. Bright even light, no giant dragon sculpture, fantasy towers, arena crowd or cosmic sky. Empty, no people or Pokemon.

center-exterior.description: ORIGINAL Viridian Center: low cream facade, red roof, central doorway and red awning, two windows, LEFT hedge, RIGHT lamp and three steps. Preserve this geometry.

center-interior.description: ORIGINAL Viridian Center: LEFT window and blue bench, central rear treatment doorway, RIGHT mint counter with cream treatment mat and small healing unit. Preserve furniture geography.

campsite-night.description: A woodland clearing off the northbound route. Low green triangular canvas tent on LEFT, two simple bowls (blue and orange) beside the entrance, a rolled tan sleeping mat partly visible inside. One sturdy fallen log on RIGHT and one low safe circular stone firepit at center foreground, unlit. Low shrubs and ordinary tree trunks behind, no deep fantasy landscape. Human heads/hands remain flat PURE WHITE with no blue/orange skin lighting.

route-practice-court.description: Distinct roadside dirt practice field: rear blue-grey fence, two low trees, path RIGHT, wooden bench LEFT. Not the earlier Pallet houses.

pewter-center.description: Distinct Pewter Center: blue bench RIGHT, mint counter BACK CENTER, treatment door BACK LEFT, narrow LEFT window, grey tiles.
